generation.scope: The full nondegenerate Klein (2,2,1,1) rank chart, including all coefficient-zero determinant fibers, is covered by the elliptic closure and the four exceptional presentations. If both determinant quadratics vanish identically the normalized base has eight explicit types, each with one bilinear equation for the entire fiber; all lie in the elliptic closure.

proof_review.scope: Reviewed primitiveness, irreducibility and specialization on the two root hypersurfaces; saturated vanishing systems and local linear solving on all components of each residual fiber.

mathematical_computation.scope: Sixteen saturated Groebner systems over the rationals, eight unit ideals and eight parametrized residual fibers, coefficientwise bilinear proportionality and localized leading units.

open_mathematics: On the fifteen-dimensional component determine whether the first edge or its single projected twenty-point scheme fixes an extension up to finitely many choices. Determine regular closed fibers using quartic centers, and analyze cross-block and conormal boundaries.
